text_blocks.snippet: Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) training is essential for financial institutions to understand and comply with the regulations aimed at encouraging them to serve the credit needs of their communities, especially low- and moderate-income (LMI) areas. Training options range from introductory overviews to in-depth courses on specific aspects of the CRA, including its impact on bank operations and compliance requirements.

list.title: Compliance:
list.snippet: The CRA requires federal bank regulators to assess a financial institution's record of meeting the credit needs of its community.

list.title: Community Development:
list.snippet: Training helps banks understand how to effectively serve their communities, including LMI areas, through lending, investments, and services.

list.title: Operational Efficiency:
list.snippet: CRA compliance impacts various aspects of a bank's operations, including expansion, mergers, and obtaining regulatory approvals.

list.title: Public Understanding:
list.snippet: CRA training helps institutions communicate their commitment to community reinvestment to the public and stakeholders.

list.title: Modernization:
list.snippet: Training is crucial for understanding and implementing the new CRA modernization rules that took effect in 2024, according to the Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA).

list.title: Introductory Courses:
list.snippet: Provide a general overview of the CRA's purpose, regulatory requirements, and impact on bank activities.

list.title: Specialized Courses:
list.snippet: Focus on specific areas like small bank examinations, retail lending tests, or HMDA (Home Mortgage Disclosure Act) reporting.

list.title: CRA Officer Training:
list.snippet: For those who manage a bank's CRA program, training may cover best practices, compliance management, and performance evaluation.

list.title: Modernization Training:
list.snippet: Addresses the changes introduced by the CRA Modernization Final Rule, including assessment areas, performance tests, and documentation requirements.

list.title: Webinars and Workshops:
list.snippet: Offer convenient and timely training on specific topics, such as new regulations or compliance best practices.

list.title: American Bankers Association (ABA):
list.snippet: Offers online courses for member banks, including introductory and specialized training on CRA.

list.title: Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA):
list.snippet: Provides in-person and virtual training for bank employees and board members on various aspects of CRA.

list.title: National Community Reinvestment Coalition (NCRC):
list.snippet: Offers online and in-person training, webinars, and technical assistance to organizations involved in community development.

list.title: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC):
list.snippet: Provides training programs for bank examiners, including courses on the CRA and its examination procedures.

list.title: Vubiz:
list.snippet: Offers online courses focused on the CRA, including courses tailored for small banks and introductory overviews.

list.title: Bank Webinars:
list.snippet: Offers webinars on various aspects of the CRA, including the new modernization rules.
